mapper.sql: DATAID, INTERF_TYPE, FIRE_NAME, STATUS, UPDATE_USER, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME, WORKFLOW_ID, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_DEPT
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO CHB_INTERF_ERRODATA CII USING (
SELECT '${item.datauuid}' DATAUUID, '${item.dataid}' DATAID, '${item.interfType}' INTERF_TYPE, '${item.fireName}' FIRE_NAME, '${item.orgData}' ORG_DATA, '${item.errMsg}' ERR_MSG, '${item.status}' STATUS, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME, '${item.workflowId}' WORKFLOW_ID, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, '${item.orgCode}' ORG_CODE, '${item.deptCode}' DEPT_CODE FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.DATAID = TEMP.DATAID)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.INTERF_TYPE = TEMP.INTERF_TYPE,CII.FIRE_NAME = TEMP.FIRE_NAME, CII.ORG_DATA =TEMP.ORG_DATA,CII.ERR_MSG = TEMP.ERR_MSG, CII.STATUS =TEMP.STATUS,CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.CREATE_USER =TEMP.CREATE_USER,CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.DEPT_CODE =TEMP.DEPT_CODE,CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CII.WORKFLOW_ID = TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID,CII.UPDATE_TIME = sysdate
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DATAUUID,DATAID, INTERF_TYPE, FIRE_NAME, ORG_DATA,ERR_MSG, STATUS, UPDATE_USER, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME, WORKFLOW_ID, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_DEPT) VALUES(TEMP.DATAUUID,TEMP.DATAID, TEMP.INTERF_TYPE, TEMP.FIRE_NAME, TEMP.ORG_DATA,TEMP.ERR_MSG, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT)
